description: This file contains the definition of the Cart class within the Opencart System Library, specifically handling shopping cart operations like adding products, retrieving cart contents, managing product options, discounts, and special prices. It interacts with the database for cart management and product data processing.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Represents the shopping cart functionality, including managing cart items, handling product options, discounts, and summarizing cart data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cart object with dependencies like database, configuration, customer, session, and tax; also clears expired carts and updates the session and customer cart data.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products in the cart, including applying discounts, specials, and handling product options.

methods.name: hasStock
methods.description: Checks if all products in the cart are in stock.

methods.name: hasShipping
methods.description: Determines if any product in the cart requires shipping.

methods.name: hasDownload
methods.description: Checks if any product in the cart is a downloadable item.
